title: Triplets record, Auto shows the whole loop
thisBuild: The finer time grid: each sixteenth now has 24 ticks inside it. Triplet and dotted repeats record while you play, and land exactly between the sixteenths.
On Steps, hits between the sixteenths show as thin marks inside the step where they fall.
Settings, Playing: Recording snapped to 16ths (as before) or exactly where you hit. Exact keeps your timing as you played it.
Auto shows the whole loop now, every bar across the lane, with a bright line at each bar.
watch: Record a 1/16 triplet repeat over a loop and play it back: does it sound the way you played it?
Try Recording exactly where you hit for a while: does your playing feel more like you?
limits: Keys and chords played on the Padiano still record on the sixteenths; the finer grid is for pad hits and repeats.
Tapping a step on Steps flips the step itself; to remove a hit between the sixteenths, clear the row.
Lengthening a loop copies its steps into the new bars, but not its in-between hits yet.
